title: Control Flow (Part 1) - `if`/`else` expressions
learning_objectives: Use `if`, `else if`, and `else` to branch on conditions.
Return values from each branch of an `if` expression.
Recognize why every branch must produce the same type.
explanation: This slice focuses on `if` expressions rather than the whole control-flow toolbox. In Rust, branching can produce a value, so each branch must agree on the return type and cover the cases the function cares about.

examples.title: Choose a label with `if` and `else`
Handle three outcomes with `else if`

completion_criteria: Exercise tests pass for negative, zero, and positive inputs
Learner can explain why every `if` branch in the function returns the same kind of value
